extracted.intended_audience: aspiring creative writers; students learning narrative point of view
extracted.subtask_description: Provide concrete examples and brief explanations of first-, second-, and third-person narrative points of view, showing the pronouns used and how each positions the narrator/reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: First-person POV
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: “We walked through the forest, feeling the damp leaves under our feet.” (Shows the narrator is a participant and relates events from their personal perspective.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Second-person POV
rubrics_metrics.description: Uses “you” and related forms like “your” to make the reader the protagonist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: “You step into the room, heart racing as the shadows shift around you.” (Addresses the reader directly, placing them in the story.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-person POV
rubrics_metrics.description: Uses character names or pronouns like “he,” “she,” or “they.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: “Anna walked into the room, feeling a shiver run down her spine.” (Narration refers to characters from an external vantage point.)
